decisions.guard_extension: precondition: non-fused RotaryEmbedding path in packed mode: attention must forward the provided cu_doc_lens to the rotary module so positions restart at each document boundary
decisions.note: invariance_across_config re-resolved to index_consistency from the relation statement (applied rotary position must equal the intended per-document position); independent of OC-NEW-13 (cu_doc_lens not forwarded at all vs per-element boundaries in batched packing).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: WarmupLR without an explicit warmup_max_lr must inherit the user-configured optimizer param-group learning rate as its peak LR, not a hard-coded default
decisions.note: value_scaling_consistency re-resolved to config_effectiveness: the witness is effective peak LR vs the user's own configured optimizer LR, not a scale factor in the training path.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: self-attention output_gate under TP with num_query_groups < tensor_model_parallel_size: each TP rank must apply its own gate slice aligned with its query-group partition, not the full unsliced gate
decisions.note: structural_integrity re-resolved to sharding_layout_consistency (rank consumes slice_r(gate), already T25's schema form); independent of seed case M-023 (different gate module and defect).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fused-boundary label offsetting on variable-length byte batches: the boundary mask must be ANDed with the byte validity mask so padded positions keep ignore_index and contribute zero loss
decisions.note: Same exclusivity relation over loss contributions at padding positions (labels leaving ignore_index at pad positions make padding contribute to CE); difference is a precondition guard.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-3 quantized-gradient (qgZ) all-to-all reduction must slice communication buffers by the actual node-local world size (no hard-coded GPUs-per-node count), matching the unquantized allreduce reference within quantization error
decisions.note: invariance_across_config (alias reference_equivalence): quantized vs standard gradient reduction is a performance-neutral knob whose paired-run witness is T03's signal class.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: group-limited MoE routing: the realized per-token selected-expert count must equal the configured topk (inner topk call must use topk, not num_groups)
decisions.note: count_frequency_match re-resolved to config_effectiveness following the OC-NEW-6 sliding-window-extent precedent: realized selected-expert count vs the user-configured topk.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: SP>1; precondition: sequence-parallel communication buffers must honor the configured seq_parallel_communication_data_type (the consumed config key must match the user-facing spelling, no silent ignore)
decisions.note: Follows the T05 communication_data_type precedent: the designated dtype of SP communication buffers is the user-configured value.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: AutoEP MoE under ZeRO-2: the per-rank loss must carry the ep_size factor before backward so reduced expert gradients match the ep_size=1 baseline
decisions.note: Missing ep_size multiplicative factor on the loss/expert-gradient path; independent of D-NEW-73 (manual-API parity incident).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: Post-LN (norm_after) sequential block: the attention normalization must be applied to the attention output immediately before the residual add, per the Post-LN reference formula, not to the QKV projection output
decisions.note: ordering re-resolved to reference_equivalence: norm placement is normalization-formula conformance against the Post-LN spec, witnessed by residual-input statistics vs the reference block formula.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: fp16 fused-optimizer global grad norm under TP: every TP rank's slices of genuinely TP-sliced parameters must contribute to the norm (replicated params counted once), not only tp_rank 0
decisions.note: conservation re-resolved to value_scaling_consistency: grads_for_norm completeness over TP shards is already T09's schema clause.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: modules re-wrapped by a sharding framework (FSDP/FSDP2) after construction must cast input activations using the live parameter dtype at forward time, not a construction-time dtype snapshot
decisions.note: Input activation at kernel entry must carry the designated (live post-wrapping parameter) dtype.
Per-param-group LR-list cardinality matches no existing template's objects and no earlier singleton shares relation+objects.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: block-level MuReadout (ff_proj) under use_mup: block reset_parameters must not unconditionally re-apply generic normal init over the muP-prescribed zero/special readout init
decisions.note: Init statistics must conform to the muP prescription; independent of the earlier model-level muP-readout support (different module and defect).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: readout ff_out must be constructed with the configured init_device so the meta-init/FSDP materialization pipeline applies the designed init scale (no default-device kaiming escape)
decisions.note: Post-init weight statistics escape the configured init pipeline via a missing device kwarg; independent of O-NEW-55 and of the torch>=2.1 reset_parameters support (different defects).
Label-index range validity shares no objects with the existing boundedness templates/singletons.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-1/2 with use_multi_rank_bucket_allreduce=False: the single-destination reduce path must produce gradients on the receiving rank equivalent to the bucket-allreduce path (the passed destination rank must not be silently overridden to None)
decisions.note: invariance_across_config (alias reference_equivalence): collective-path selection is a performance-neutral knob; witness is a paired-config gradient checksum comparison.

decisions.guard_extension: topology: TP>1 and EP>1; precondition: MoE checkpoint save with expert parallelism and TP>1 must write every TP rank's non-expert model-states shard (not only mp_rank_00, no exp_dp_rank short-circuit) so each TP rank restores its own saved shard
decisions.note: Primary relation is per-TP-rank save/restore equality keyed to the correct rank; the missing-file count is the secondary witness only.
Zero loss-normalization divisor under full instance masking is T14's existing precondition verbatim; different repo from O-015, counts independently.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: ZeRO-1/2 overlap_comm: the compute stream must wait on the reduction stream before the next gradient bucket is written into the shared ipg buffer an in-flight allreduce is still reading
decisions.note: Classic producer-consumer stream hazard: buffer rewrite must happen-after the in-flight allreduce read completes.

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: document-boundary/EOS handling must use the configured tokenizer's actual eos_token_id, not a hard-coded token id
decisions.note: config_honoring already aliases to config_effectiveness: the effective boundary token id must equal the value implied by the configured tokenizer (named-data-mix resolution precedent).

decisions.guard_extension: topology: PP>1; precondition: encoder-decoder pipeline boundary with encoder TP < decoder TP: cross-stage gradients received from multiple decoder TP ranks must be averaged, not summed (no TP-fanout inflation of the boundary gradient)
decisions.note: Boundary gradient carries a spurious TP-fanout multiplicative factor; sum-vs-mean is a scale-factor obligation.

decisions.guard_extension: phase: optimizer_step; precondition: adaptive gradient clipping with grad_norm_exp_avg tracking: each step's observed gradient norm must enter the EMA update exactly once (the EMA must never be updated from its own previous value)
decisions.note: Exactly-once incorporation of the per-step observation into a statistic update (count(event, step)==1, violated with count 0 by the self-referential update).

decisions.guard_extension: phase: any; precondition: per-layer auxiliary (MTP) loss tracking with log_interval>1: each iteration's loss must be accumulated into the logging-window tracker exactly once, not overwritten by assignment
decisions.note: conservation re-resolved to count_frequency_match: same aux-loss-tracker object and exactly-once-per-iteration event as T26 support M-NEW-21 (there double-counted under recompute, here dropped by overwrite).

Same-incident (§4.1) with existing T13 support O-NEW-53: identical trainer epoch-rollover start_index-not-reset trigger already recorded near-verbatim in T13's preconditions, so it counts once (support unchanged).

decisions.guard_extension: precondition: cached rotary sin/cos tables under bf16/fp16 mixed precision must be cast to the query/key compute dtype at the point of application
decisions.note: RoPE cache dtype at the application site must equal the designated compute dtype under the mixed-precision recipe.
